summary: Iteration 11 - Security hardening validation. All 8 hardening surfaces verified: must_change_password flow, wrong-pw 401, secret masking in GET /api/settings + empty-string keep-existing on POST, POST /api/logout invalidates token, TOKEN_TTL=43200 present + expired token popped on _check, CORS rejects https://evil.com preflight and allows Origin 'null', engine.redact_url masks user:pass in camera_log 'PROBE start' lines, whatsapp/test falls back to stored key gracefully with empty body (no 500), electron-main.js open-path allowlist under os.homedir() -> 'blocked' otherwise, index.html has CSP meta with connect-src http://127.0.0.1:8971 and no external Google Fonts. E2E via Playwright: default login shows force-change form, all 3 validations (min 6 chars, mismatch, '9xsecurity' rejected) surface correct error messages via data-testid=force-change-error, setting GateTest#77 lands on dashboard, logout button in sidebar works (calls /api/logout, sessionStorage cleared, back to login), old default returns 401 'Galat username ya password.', new password logs in DIRECTLY to dashboard (must_change_password false). Settings > WhatsApp: input value empty and placeholder '•••• saved hai — badalne ke liye naya daalein' when secret is stored; Send Test with empty key returns backend graceful 401 toast (fallback to stored key wiring correct). 19/19 test_engine.py regression pass (spec mentioned 20 but only 19 tests exist in file - not a regression I introduced). 12/12 new tests pass in tests/test_security_iter11.py.
critical_code_review_comments: test_engine.py contains 19 tests, not the 20 stated in the review request - verify whether a test was accidentally removed during hardening or the request count was stale (not a functional issue).

api.js hardcodes BASE=http://127.0.0.1:${window.ENGINE_PORT||8971}. This is intentional for the Electron file:// origin (CORS 'null' allowed), but blocks browser access via http://localhost:8971. Tester used http://127.0.0.1:8971 (same-origin) which works. Consider using relative paths when served from same-origin static so container/dev testing works with either localhost or 127.0.0.1; low priority given production is Electron file://.

Force-change flow calls POST /api/settings with only {new_password}; SettingsPage 'security' tab also does the same via newPass. Both paths reset password but do not clear the must_change flag until next login (natural because must_change is derived from hash comparison to default). Acceptable behavior.
test_credentials: admin / 9xsecurity (default). During E2E password was temporarily changed to GateTest#77 and restored to 9xsecurity at cleanup. wa_api_key/gh_token/wa_recipients/wa_account_password also cleared from config.json.
seed_data_creation: None persisted; all writes reverted in fixture teardown + explicit cleanup snippet.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Service runs on http://127.0.0.1:8971 (also reachable via localhost but CORS blocks non-127.0.0.1 origins because Electron production origin is file:// -> 'null'). Use http://127.0.0.1:8971 for browser E2E to avoid CORS. Default credentials are admin/9xsecurity and must_change_password=true is the correct signal while config still holds default hash. All hardening from this iteration is in place and verified.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found; this iteration was verification of security fixes SEC-001 and SEC-003 plus hardening additions. All 20 listed acceptance checks pass.
